checks.name: Design token tests: WCAG contrast both themes, completeness, CSS drift, no hard-coded brand name/hex in apps
Chromium specimen render with Arabic font load assertion (light/dark x ar/en x phone/desktop)
Regression: clean-clone workspace check (apps consume tokens)

scenarios.observed: Brand name, slogan, colors, typography and spacing live only in packages/design-tokens/tokens.json; customer web, operations web and the Expo app read them (tests assert app titles derive from tokens and that app source contains no hard-coded brand name or hex color), so name/logo/colors change without business-code edits. Contrast tests pass for every listed pair in light and dark themes (text >=4.5:1, focus and borderStrong >=3:1). Chromium rendered 8 specimens (light/dark x ar/en x 390/1280 px) with IBM Plex Sans Arabic loaded (document.fonts checks), showing the draft wordmark, Arabic glyph set, Arabic-Indic and Latin digits, bidi-isolated mixed content and contrast swatches. Trademark clearance remains OPEN (O05).

findings: Visual self-review of rendered specimens found unisolated mixed-direction amounts, an off-center button label and 1.5:1 border contrast unsuitable for form controls; fixed with <bdi> runs, inline-flex centering and a tested borderStrong token (>=3:1). Bracket mirroring in the Arabic total line verified by measuring glyph positions.
Brand, wordmark and palette are drafts for owner review (O05); no trademark search performed.
Font licensing: IBM Plex Sans Arabic under OFL-1.1 via @fontsource 5.3.0.
Native app uses token values but native rendering/fonts are not verified on devices (MB-005 native BLOCKED; P07).
